title: Benefit Formulas (T09)
intro: The T09 register: benefit, baseline driver, change assumption, formula, ramp and confidence. Formulas use a small, safe expression language; every value is an exact decimal and a fraction is stored as a fraction (12% is 0.12).
registerIntro: Each row keeps its formula in immutable versions. Finance validates each version; a new version starts Not validated.
emptyBody: Add a formula, or start from one of the two illustrative source examples below.
rowIntro: The six T09 columns. The formula itself changes only through a new version.

create.title: New benefit formula (T09)
create.description: Create the T09 row; you then write its formula in the builder, which saves version 1.

examples.title: Source examples (B0087)
examples.intro: The two worked examples of the playbook, with synthetic values. They are illustrations, not Mobily figures.
examples.instantiate: Use this example in the register

builder.title: Formula builder
builder.intro: Write the formula and declare its typed variables. It is checked and previewed as you type; saving creates the next version, which starts Not validated.
builder.typeToCheck: Type a formula to check it.
builder.noValues: Some variables have no value yet
builder.inexact: A division or period conversion was rounded to 80 significant digits before the single storage rounding.
builder.expressionHint: Variables in lower case (a–z, 0–9, _), numbers with a dot, + − × ÷, parentheses, min, max, abs and to_period(x, month|quarter|year).
builder.grammarHint: Only this small expression language is accepted; nothing you type is run as code.
builder.saved: Version {{n}} saved. It is Not validated until Finance validates it.

variables.title: Typed variables
variables.hint: Each variable has a kind, a unit or currency and a period. Enter a fraction as a percent (12 for 12%) and a fraction difference in percentage points; they are stored as fractions.
variables.name: Name

valueHint.percentage_points: Enter 2 for 2 percentage points; stored as 0.02.
valueHint.plain: Latin digits and a dot; leave empty when unknown (the preview is then Unknown).

syntaxReason.character: a character that the formula language does not allow
syntaxReason.number_digits: a number with too many digits
syntaxReason.identifier_length: a variable name that is too long
syntaxReason.unknown_function: an unknown function (use min, max, abs or to_period)
syntaxReason.period: a period name is allowed only as the second argument of to_period
syntaxReason.arity: a function with the wrong number of arguments
syntaxReason.too_long: the formula is longer than {{limit}} characters
syntaxReason.too_many_nodes: the formula has more than {{limit}} parts
syntaxReason.too_deep: the formula is nested deeper than {{limit}} levels
syntaxReason.too_many_variables: the formula uses more than {{limit}} variables
syntaxReason.internal: the formula could not be processed

engine.currency_product: {{left}} and {{right}} are both currency amounts and cannot be multiplied.
engine.currency_mismatch: Currency mismatch: {{left}} is in {{leftCurrency}} but {{right}} is in {{rightCurrency}}; there is no FX conversion.
engine.periodMismatch: Period mismatch: {{left}} is per {{leftPeriod}} but {{right}} is per {{rightPeriod}}; convert with to_period({{left}}, {{convertTo}}).
engine.periodVsNone: Period mismatch: {{left}} is per {{leftPeriod}} but {{right}} has no period.
engine.periodNeedsPeriod: Period mismatch: to_period needs a value with a period, but {{left}} has no period.

variableReason.name: the name must start with a lower-case letter and use only a–z, 0–9 and _
variableReason.reserved: the name is reserved (to_period, min, max, abs, month, quarter, year)
variableReason.currency: a currency amount needs an ISO currency code (for example SAR), and only a currency amount has one
variableReason.value: the value must be a decimal with Latin digits and at most 6 decimals

engine.division_by_zero: Division by zero: {{divisor}} is 0; the result is Unknown.
engine.missing_input: Missing input: {{names}}; the result is Unknown.
engine.result_out_of_range: Result out of range: {{value}} does not fit the stored precision.

versions.title: Versions and Finance validation
versions.intro: Versions are immutable. Finance validation of a version is a business approval by Finance, never by the version's author, and is final once recorded.
versions.authorCannot: You created this version, so you cannot validate it (separation of duties).
versions.dialogBody: Record your Finance decision on the benefit logic of this version. It is final; a later change needs a new version.
versions.previewUnknown: No preview: a value was missing or the evaluation failed

calc.title: Preview calculations and lineage
calc.intro: Each recorded calculation keeps its inputs, period, assumptions, engine version and rounding. A missing input or a division by zero gives Unknown, never 0.
calc.empty: No calculation recorded for this version yet.
calc.runIntro: The inputs start from the version's values. The calculation is recorded with its lineage; it changes nothing else.

problems.formula__syntax: The formula has a syntax error. Nothing was saved.
problems.formula__undefined_variable: The formula uses an undefined variable. Nothing was saved.
problems.formula__kind_mismatch: The formula combines kinds that do not fit. Nothing was saved.
problems.formula__currency_product: The formula multiplies two currency amounts. Nothing was saved.
problems.formula__currency_mismatch: The formula mixes currencies; there is no FX conversion. Nothing was saved.
problems.formula__period_mismatch: The formula combines values with different periods; convert them with to_period. Nothing was saved.
problems.formula__invalid_variable: A variable declaration is not valid. Nothing was saved.
problems.formula__division_by_zero: Division by zero: the result is Unknown.
problems.formula__missing_input: An input is missing: the result is Unknown.
problems.formula__result_out_of_range: The result does not fit the stored precision: it is Unknown.
problems.benefit_formula__archived: Archived benefit formulas, their versions and their calculations are read-only.
problems.benefit_formula__already_archived: The benefit formula is already archived.
problems.benefit_formula__in_use: This benefit formula backs an active business case line; archive the line or unlink the formula first.
problems.benefit_formula__example_and_version: Give either a source example or a first version, not both.
problems.benefit_formula_version__validation_fina: The Finance validation of this version is final; create a new version to change the benefit logic.
problems.validation__formula_variable_name: A variable name starts with a lower-case letter and uses only a–z, 0–9 and _ (at most 48 characters).
problems.variables_invalid: Check the variables: a name, kind, currency or value is not valid. Nothing was saved.
